context: This criteria evaluates how effectively an engineer uses the babel-plugin-react-compiler API to configure custom hooks, validation rules, feature gating, and compilation behavior. The focus is exclusively on correct usage of package-specific configuration options and APIs.

checklist.name: Plugin Configuration Structure
checklist.description: Correctly structures a Babel configuration with babel-plugin-react-compiler in the plugins array, passing configuration options as the second element of a plugin tuple (e.g., ['babel-plugin-react-compiler', options]).

checklist.name: Custom Hook Definition
checklist.description: Defines a custom hook 'useDataFetcher' in the environment.customHooks configuration using a Map data structure with the hook name as the key.

checklist.name: Hook Effect Kind
checklist.description: Sets the effectKind property correctly for the custom hook to indicate read-only access (e.g., Effect.Read or the string 'Read').

checklist.name: Hook Value Kind
checklist.description: Sets the valueKind property correctly for the custom hook to indicate non-constant mutable values (e.g., ValueKind.Mutable or similar appropriate value kind).

checklist.name: Hook Alias Configuration
checklist.description: Sets noAlias to true in the custom hook configuration to indicate arguments should not be aliased.

checklist.name: Hook Data Transitivity
checklist.description: Sets transitiveMixedData to true in the custom hook configuration to indicate the return value contains JSON-serializable data.

checklist.name: Ref Validation
checklist.description: Enables validateRefAccessDuringRender in the environment configuration to validate that refs are not accessed during render.

checklist.name: Effect Dependency Validation
checklist.description: Enables validateMemoizedEffectDependencies in the environment configuration to validate that effect dependencies are properly memoized.

checklist.name: Capitalized Call Validation
checklist.description: Configures validateNoCapitalizedCalls in the environment to check for unsafe capitalized function calls, using either a boolean true or an object with an allowlist.

checklist.name: Allowlist Configuration
checklist.description: If validateNoCapitalizedCalls is an object, includes an allowlist array with the allowed component names: 'App', 'Header', and 'Footer'.

checklist.name: Gating Configuration
checklist.description: Configures the gating option as an object with both 'source' and 'importSpecifierName' properties to enable feature-flagged compilation.

checklist.name: Gating Source Module
checklist.description: Sets the gating.source property to '@company/feature-flags' to specify the module to import the feature flag from.

checklist.name: Gating Function Name
checklist.description: Sets the gating.importSpecifierName property to 'isCompilerEnabled' to specify the named export to use as the gating function.

checklist.name: Compilation Mode
checklist.description: Sets the compilationMode option to 'infer' to automatically detect React components and hooks for compilation.

checklist.name: Panic Threshold
checklist.description: Sets the panicThreshold option to 'none' to configure the compiler to continue compilation without throwing exceptions on errors.
